alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 27 at 1:55AM EST until November 27 at 12:00PM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
* WHAT...Up to one foot of inundation above ground level in low
lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in the District of Columbia, Arlington
County, and the City of Alexandria.

* WHEN...Until noon EST today, especially around the time of
high tide.

* IMPACTS...Water is expected to approach buildings near King
Street and Union Street. The unprotected area on the Southwest
Waterfront at the DC Seafood Market is expected to flood. Water
is expected to approach parts of the Hains Point Loop Road, but
it will likely be closed.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 1:39PM EST until November 27 at 11:00PM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
* WHAT...Around one foot of inundation above ground level in low
lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in the District of Columbia, Arlington
County, and the City of Alexandria.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM EST this evening, especially around the
time of high tide.

* IMPACTS....Water is expected to approach the curb near the
intersection of King Street and Strand Street in Alexandria. Low
lying areas near Fletchers Boathouse begin to flood. Portions
of Roosevelt Island are flooded.
